intro: "Swamp Eye" Jarl, in Dustwallow Marsh, has cutting to do and will not say what. Jarl wants a certain blade, a moonsteel broadsword, and does not want you to dawdle.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have cutting to do. I can't tell you what I'm going to cut, but... I need myself a blade. A certain blade...
Some people call it a moonsteel broadsword. I call it a swing blade.
You help me? Maybe you find it in town, maybe you talk to a blacksmith and he'll make it special.
But don't sleep on this. What I'm cutting won't keep forever...

clips.title: Completion
paras: That's a good blade. It has a good swing. It's a good swing blade. Thank you. Thank you, thank you, thank you!!! Now I want to try it....
Later. I'll try it later. But like I was saying... Thanks.
